ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web, with Sun at the bottom, and arrows pointing to Trees and Grass. Grass is located at the bottom of the food web, and has arrows pointing to animals such as Mouse, Rabbit, Deer, and Cricket. The image also includes consumers such as Frog, Snake, Hawk, Mountain lion, and King cobra. Reasoning: In a food web, plants that can use sunlight to make their own food and provide an energy source for animals belong to producers. Grass is a plant and obtains energy from Sun, so the role of Grass is Producer.
